title: Exoskeleton
move_pattern: Initial move depends on slot position. Then cycles through random selections between Skitter and Mandibles, with Enrage following each Mandibles attack.
notes: Behavior is conditional on monster slot position. In slot 1 starts with Skitter, slot 2 with Mandibles, slot 3 with Enrage, and slot 4 with a random choice. Subsequent move cycling follows the same pattern regardless of starting position: random choice between Skitter/Mandibles, with Enrage always following Mandibles before the next random selection.
